title: Topological sort with cycle reporting
prompt: Write topo.js exporting topoSort(deps), where deps is an object mapping each task name to the array of task names it depends on (names that only appear as dependencies count as tasks too). Return an array with every task, each after all of its dependencies. When several tasks are ready at the same time, take them in alphabetical order so the result is deterministic. If there is a cycle, throw an Error whose message contains the cycle written like 'a -> b -> a'.
